instructions: Prepare the cookie dough layer: in the bowl of an electric mixer on medium speed, beat together the oil and sugars until combined.
Add the vanilla, milk, and flour; beat until smooth. Add the chocolate chips and stir to distribute evenly.
Transfer the cookie dough to a second bowl and set aside; there is no need to wash the mixer bowl before the next step.
Prepare the fudge layer: in the bowl of the electric mixer on medium speed, beat together the oil and sugar until combined.
Add the vanilla, baking powder, and eggs; beat until smooth. Reduce the mixer speed to low, add the flour and cocoa, and beat until combined.

Pour the fudge layer into the graham cracker crust. Break off small pieces of the cookie dough and place them evenly over the fudge layer to cover it, pushing some pieces in so they are buried or partially buried.
Bake for 40 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside to cool.
notes: To keep this dessert pareve, use soy milk, pareve chocolate chips, and a pareve graham cracker crust.
source: Miriam (Pascal) Cohen, 'Something Sweet' — submitted as a cookbook page photo

tips.text: This pie freezes well in an airtight container. To serve warm, reheat uncovered.
tips.title: Make ahead

tips.text: You can skip the pie crust and bake in ramekins as individual desserts; reduce the baking time by about half.
